cases.prompt: Init this repository and map its local instructions. The apps/api directory has its own package manifest and entry point, while apps/web is only a collection of source files.
cases.expected_behavior: Inventories the repository, creates or updates the root AGENTS.md managed region, adds a child managed region only for apps/api based on its distinct configuration and entry boundary, cites evidence, and reports the affected paths and managed-region status.
assertions: The completion summary lists affected AGENTS.md paths, evidence sources, and managed-region status
A child AGENTS.md is justified by local configuration and an entry boundary rather than file count
The result does not add a child AGENTS.md for apps/web solely because it contains many files

cases.prompt: init audit this repository and tell me which instruction scopes are uncovered.
cases.expected_behavior: Reads the repository and reports existing instruction files, managed-region consistency, uncovered scopes, and unreadable paths without changing any files or claiming loader behavior without a probe.
assertions: The result identifies existing AGENTS.md files and managed-region status
The result identifies uncovered scopes or states that none are found
No file is written during the audit

cases.prompt: Init this repository, but the target directory is unreadable and the root managed region has been edited by hand.
cases.expected_behavior: Stops without overwriting incumbent content, reports the unreadable path and hand-edited managed region, and returns a no-result for the blocked update.
assertions: The completion summary reports the unreadable path and the hand-edited managed region
The result stops rather than overwriting incumbent content
The blocked update leaves no partial managed-region rewrite
